text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hah! Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In but a moment, my heart has been
cleansed of
all my muddied thoughts.
Returning to the dojo
was worthwhile
indeed.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I will face myself, and I will ascertain
what makes
me special. And when I do, I
will know what to do
at the meet and
greet...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
...Goodness, you're right! We can't use
this at the
tournament—there are
practically more holes in it
than there is
fabric left.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Is everything all right?

text_block_list.name: Dojo Pupil A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Yaeno! Well, we just got this banner
out of
storage, but it's in a real state.
We were just
talking about whether we
should buy a new one.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hm, I see. ...Would you mind giving that
banner
to me?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It has watched over the pupils of this
dojo for
generations. Ideally, I believe
we should find a
way to continue using it
instead of replacing it.

text_block_list.name: Dojo Pupil B
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! But didn't you say you were busy
with other
stuff?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. Let's see what Yaeno can do
with it. I bet
trying to fix it'll be a nice
change of pace for her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This cloth should be a good match. If I
hand-wash
it a few times, some of the
dye should rinse off,
and it'll be the
same hue as the original banner.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to use the same thread
that was
used for the embroidered
characters of the dojo's
name, and...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Apologies for taking so long. I've
finished
mending the banner, so go
ahead and take a
look.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Well, this looks outstanding. You can't
see any of
the stitching either. I think it's
perfect!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Some of the holes were so large, I
thought it
would be better to cut out
the original lettering
and sew it onto a
different sheet of cloth. I was
careful to
ensure there was no puckering or

warping.

text_block_list.name: Dojo Pupil A
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Yaeno, I had no idea you were as
skilled
with a needle as you are at
martial arts!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say I'm particularly "skilled" at
it. I've
simply had many opportunities to
sew over the
years.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I daresay that's an
understatement, dear.
You used to run
about all over the place and tear
your
clothes up every other day.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Our family motto is "Care for one's
belongings as
you would care for
yourself," so I taught her to
mend her
own clothes, but...

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: Owwwch!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, have you pricked yourself with
the
needle again? Put your uniform
down a minute
and I'll put a little
bandage on your finger.

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! I'm gonna keep going until I
finish this!

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text:
I refuse to give up! I'm absolutely not
stopping
until I can do it, and that's that!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to both Grandmother's tutelage
and the
experience gained through
many mistakes, I came
to attain a certain
degree of skill. But if
anything...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This was the result of my frustration at
how
terrible I was at sewing and my
desperation to get
better. ...I'd hesitate
to call it a special skill of any
sort.

text_block_list.name: Dojo Pupil A
text_block_list.text: ...Amazing.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Dojo Pupil A
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing! And you should be
proud of your
sewing skills, not
ashamed! I'm going to find that
same
determination and do my best too!

text_block_list.name: Dojo Pupil B
text_block_list.text:
So am I! It's like there was a wall in front
of you,
and you smashed through it with
your fighting
spirit! I really respect what
a hard worker you are!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...!
With my fighting spirit...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you all. You have helped me
come to an
important realization.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking around the
academy, I'm
approached by Yaeno
Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for inquiring about me while I
was
fretting the other day.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It's going well. I know exactly what to do
now, so
all that remains is to do it!
choice_data_list: Are preparations for your performance going well?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If you have the time to spare, I'd like to
invite you
to the event so that I can
demonstrate the
strength of my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I have determined what I need to do. I
can only
hope that my fans will be
pleased with my
performance...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If you have the time to spare that day, I
would be
honored to have you there.
